description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Ibra Lebbe Mohamed Mahir as a member of the Eastern Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Ampara
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Eastern Province Provincial Council due to a resignation. It involves the electoral process under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, including the nomination of a replacement candidate by a recognized political party and the formal declaration of election by the Commissioner of Elections. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and matters, making it Type 7 (Elections).
